title: Lifecycle edges: connecting, failed, closed
blurb: Exercises the four WebTransport.getStats() state and binding branches: waiting while connecting, rejecting with InvalidStateError when failed, rejecting a Promise with TypeError on a bad receiver, and resolving final stats after close().
question: Does WebTransport.getStats() wait while connecting, reject InvalidStateError on failed sessions, return a TypeError-rejected Promise on a non-WebTransport receiver, and still resolve final stats after close()?
result: On Chrome for Testing 153 behind --enable-blink-features=WebTransportStats, all four branches passed (connecting waited and rejected InvalidStateError no earlier than ready, failed rejected InvalidStateError, bad this returned a TypeError-rejected Promise, and post-close resolved distinct objects with identical final values against the local Deno echo server). Not verified unflagged in Chrome 160.
testedIn: Chrome for Testing 153 behind --enable-blink-features=WebTransportStats (3 serverless + local Deno QUIC echo server); not verified unflagged in Chrome 160
